articles.title: Reform UK councillors in Rochdale opt out of allowance increase
articles.excerpt: Reform UK councillors in Rochdale have formally opted out of a recently approved increase in councillor allowances, stating their decision in a public announcement.
articles.content_html:
Reform UK councillors in Rochdale have formally opted out of a recently approved increase in councillor allowances. The decision was announced on social media, where the councillors expressed their stance on the matter.

The increase in allowances was approved by the council earlier this month, but the Reform UK group has chosen not to accept the additional payments.

This move reflects the councillors' commitment to their constituents and their desire to lead by example regarding public spending.

Further details on the implications of this decision for the council's budget or future allowances have not been provided.

articles.title: Rochdale Borough's Turnout in GM Mayoral Election Recorded at 23%
articles.excerpt: A turnout figure of 23% was recorded for Rochdale borough in the Greater Manchester Mayoral Election. This statistic reflects the percentage of eligible voters who participated in the election process. The turnout is part of a broader trend observed across the region, with varying levels of engagement reported in different areas.
articles.content_html:
A turnout figure of 23% was recorded for Rochdale borough in the Greater Manchester Mayoral Election. This statistic reflects the percentage of eligible voters who participated in the election process.

The turnout is part of a broader trend observed across the region, with varying levels of engagement reported in different areas.

For further details on the election results, residents can visit the Greater Manchester Elects website.

The turnout figure may influence future electoral strategies and community engagement initiatives in the borough.
